decision.reason: [ev-7be235e771a3] says only that cert-manager adds support for the ACME profiles extension. It links the IETF draft and PR #7777, but the PR text is not shown. The note does not name the configuration that turns the feature on, such as an Issuer/ClusterIssuer field, Helm value, flag or feature gate. It also gives no default and does not say whether existing ACME issuers behave differently, so applicability cannot be written. The section context does not fill this gap: the nearby note [ev-4fcf47388827] only says cert-manager now uses a local fork of the ACME package, and PR #7777's description is needed.
